headline: Check Point PHP2Shell attacks now wipe ESXi; N-central zero-day hits patched servers; US moves on North Korean crypto theft

bullets.text: PHP2Shell (5 outlets): attackers exploiting Check Point gateway zero-day CVE-2026-123039 now deploy a VMware ESXi wiper, after gaining root and planting a TSGA backdoor. The attacks are destructive. No fixed release version is on the board.

North Korea (Binance, 5 outlets): the US moved against a North Korean crypto-theft scheme and recovered more Binance funds. The FBI says North Korean hackers stole over $400M using deepfake video calls built from stolen webcam clips of 900+ victims.

N-central (PoC, 5 outlets): the N-able zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; 21 servers infected, 19 on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions.

SilentAir hijacks Asian telecom networks to intercept calls and SMS, including 2FA codes. Also new: a China-nexus actor uses an AI tool against US defense and semiconductor firms; Mior and Skyfall attacks let rogue cloud hosts steal secrets from AMD SEV-SNP VMs.

Breaches: Uber (drivers' license data), TSMC (employees, via a cloud provider), 144,000+ Norwegian and Widerøe passengers, Apify customer data. Ransomware disrupted Belarusian cloud firm ActiveCloud for days; Maersk says a recent incident hit a legacy system.

Still active: Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618, SignDrop Windows SYSTEM zero-day, Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. KEV due 11-24: BroadWorks, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350; Barracuda ESG was due 11-13. Last 7 days run 1.14x the 90-day average.

actions: Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039, restrict gateway management access, hunt for TSGA backdoors, and confirm ESXi backups are offline.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
Prefer app or hardware-key MFA over SMS for high-value accounts; warn finance and crypto staff about deepfake video-call lures.
Patch Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618; finish Barracuda ESG now (KEV due 11-13) and queue BroadWorks, Outlook and Chromium before 11-24.
